name: FLA_INCREMENT_PERIODS
description: FLA_INCREMENT_PERIODS contains payment increase assessment periods for the payment increase agreement

columns.name: INCREMENT_PERIOD_ID
columns.description: Unique payment increase assessment period identifier.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LEASE_ID
columns.description: Lease identifier. It references the primary key of the FLA_LEASES_ALL table.

columns.name: LEASE_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Lease detail identifier. It is referenced from the FLA_LEASE_DETAILS table.

columns.name: VERSION_NUM
columns.description: Version number of the lease as captured in the FLA_LEASE_DETAILS table.

columns.name: AGREEMENT_NUMBER
columns.description: Payment increase agreement number. It is referenced from the FLA_INCREMENT_HEADERS table.

columns.name: INCREASE_PERIOD_NUM
columns.description: Payment increase assessment period number.

columns.name: ASSESSMENT_DATE
columns.description: Date when the payment increase assessment will be performed.

columns.name: FINAL_ASSESSED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the final assessment is done or not for the assessment period.

columns.name: LAST_ASSESSED_DATE
columns.description: Indicates the last date when assessment happened for the assessment period.

columns.name: INCREASE_CALC_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Defines whether to use index based, fixed rate based, or a greater or lower value of both when calculating the increase percent.

columns.name: INCREASE_PERCENT
columns.description: Increase percent as entered by user or as calculated by system for the assessment period.

columns.name: FIXED_INCREASE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Fixed increase amount as entered by user for the assessment period.

columns.name: BASIS_FACTOR_PERCENT
columns.description: Basis factor percent as entered by user for the assessment period.

columns.name: INCREASE_APPLICABLE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the payment increase is applicable for the assessment period or not.

columns.name: DATA_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Feeder system from which lease data was created.

columns.name: SCHEDULES_IMPACT_FLAG
columns.description: Flag which indicates schedules are impacted and need to be regenerated.

columns.name: CHANGE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the type of change to the record, whether INSERT or UPDATE or DELETE.

columns.name: CHANGED_IN_VERSION_NUM
columns.description: Version number in which there was a change, either an Addition or Update or Delete.

columns.name: PARENT_RECORD_ID
columns.description: Parent record identifier. This identifies the parent record for this record.

columns.name: CARRY_FORWARD_PERCENT
columns.description: Percentage of increase to be carry forwarded to next assessment period.

columns.name: INCREASE_DERIVATION_CODE
columns.description: Indicates source of increase percentage, whether index or fixed increase.

columns.name: DERIVED_FIXED_INCREASE_PERCENT
columns.description: Fixed increase percentage which was derived.

columns.name: DERIVED_INDEX_INCREASE_PERCENT
columns.description: Index based increase percentage which was derived.

columns.name: DERIVED_INDEX_FINDER_DATE
columns.description: Index date on which used to derive the index value.

columns.name: DERIVED_INDEX_VALUE
columns.description: Index value which was derived for the index finder date.

columns.name: ASSESSMENT_DERIVATION_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the way the missing index should be derived during assessment of an assessment period.

columns.name: INDEX_FINDER_MONTHS
columns.description: Indicates the check for index can span for these number of months.

columns.name: SYSTEM_ORIGIN_REFERENCE_1
columns.description: System reference column to maintain the key of source system from which lease is being imported

columns.name: SYSTEM_ORIGIN_REFERENCE_2
columns.description: System reference column to maintain the key of source system from which lease is being imported

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: PREVIOUS_DERIVED_INDEX_VALUE
columns.description: Index value which was derived for the index finder date for the previous index. This is applicable for Rolling index.

columns.name: PREVIOUS_DERIVED_INDEX_DATE
columns.description: Index date on which used to derive the index value for the previous index. This is applicable for Rolling index.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
